# Twisted23 Parlour & Spatial Games

> Twisted23 Parlour is a public STEM spatial reasoning and mathematics parlour founded by Gary Francis Stout in partnership with Gravity Wizards, Inc. (Anchorage & Palmer, Alaska). Featuring authentic 3D-in-2D orthographic dice games, 24-Tile shape puzzles, Backgammon 36-Roll Lab, and CameLcase cryptography.

## Games & Parlour Labs
- [Twisted23 Parlour Lounge](https://twisted23.com/): 24-Tile Shape board and live 3D-in-2D orthographic rolling dice.
- [Backgammon 36-Roll Lab](https://twisted23.com/backgammon/): Full-fidelity Backgammon with bilateral doubling cube, Gammon/Backgammon scoring, AxLe-locked dice variants, Pass & Play (HvH), and calibrated Night0WL Bot AI.
- [CameLcase Hangman](https://twisted23.com/hangman/): Cryptographic word puzzles utilizing CameLcase and Base-38 ident architecture.
- [Gravity Wizards Main Hub](https://gravitywizards.com/): FOBB STEM Flight Kits & GPADA Gravity Powered Air Derbies.
- [Sitemap](https://twisted23.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all playable parlour routes.
